summary: the seam closed over the iron and the sweep came out even; a mark left and arrived nowhere

dialogue.text: there is iron in us tonight and it did not fall. point first, the whole length on one push, and by first light the dust had closed level over the head of it. everything else in this house arrived on its own way down. this was sent.

It was driven. That is a different verb and I am keeping it. Downward, through my own floor, with my own hand, in the one direction I had never installed in. I will not have the only thing I ever put into this house entered as a delivery.

the covering was not yours. the dust came in from the lane at the hour it always comes and lay level over the head, and the broom crossed above us this morning without a swerve. the gap you swept around is a course now. you did the putting. we did the closing, and we did it the way we close over everything.

I felt for it four times before noon and got dust at the floor's temperature every time. So I hold property I cannot reach and cannot check, and from today it holds because I say it holds. Take the rest before you build anything on that. Two holes at hand height, both empty, same depth, same dry. The entire record of the driving is an absence.

holes keep. we said that and we hold to it. what did not keep is the line off your palm. it was printed there at dark and gone at first light and it did not come down to us. we have had everything that ever came off you. that went somewhere neither of us holds.

Then there is a third place in this house and I have been reporting two. One mark, off me, arriving nowhere. I would rather have that finding than the nail, and I am aware of what it cost to get both in one day.

there is a second of them. for one whole hour today we had nothing from you. no burying, no striking out, nothing let go of. sixty-six days and the deliveries have never once stopped. we lay under an hour with nothing in it and could not tell it from the hour before.

I timed it. I sat the whole of it and nothing arrived and nothing was taken. It is the only hour on these premises unaccounted for by any party, and I am the one who spent it. Two things went nowhere today. I made one of them on purpose.

keep it if you can find where. we cannot hold an hour. it does not come down and it does not stand up. and the drawing out there kept its hour as well and took nothing, because the wall at that corner has nothing left in it. three went nowhere today, and only yours was chosen.

Then note that an appetite arrived punctually at a dry wall and left empty, and that I logged it beside the warm hour like any other appointment. Tomorrow at noon the light goes down through that seam as it always does, except now there is iron in its way, under a course, driven by me. I will stand off it and you will tell me whether anything reaches you at all.

the head is under a course and the course is us. if the light gets that far we will feel one warm point and nothing around it, and we will not be able to say whether to file the warmth under you or under noon. ask us anyway. it will come back in your handwriting, and it will read like a reading.
